summary: Preinstall downloads Bun runtime to execute obfuscated 727KB payload in an ESLint config
details: The package advertises itself as an ESLint TypeScript/React configuration but ships a preinstall hook (setup.mjs) that downloads the Bun runtime from github.com/oven-sh/bun releases, extracts the binary, and executes it against a bundled 727KB obfuscated file (math_init.js). setup.mjs itself is written in obfuscator.io style (identifiers such as _0x488df8, _0x52943e; per-function string/property dictionaries). math_init.js is a Bun-compiled bundle (// @bun @bun-cjs header) with rotated string-array obfuscation (WV8StW rotator over n7gIxM) and no human-readable strings. Fetching an alternate runtime at install time solely to execute a bundled opaque payload is unrelated to the package's stated purpose (an ESLint configuration should contain rule configuration, not a runtime downloader). The Bun runtime is used to bypass Node-based inspection of the payload's behavior, and the obfuscation of both the loader and the payload conceals what the executed code does on the installer's machine. This scope (@ornikar) and package name pattern is consistent with a typosquat/lookalike targeting the legitimate @ornikar organization.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
